import os
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    """Replace the all-zero top row with a copy of the bottom row."""\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    if out and out[0] and all(value == 0 for value in out[0]):\n        out[0] = out[-1][:]\n    return out\n'''
p=base/'task-74f9bf92.py'
p.write_text(source)
# Verify on the received demo and run on test input.
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*7,[7]*7,[6]*7,[6]*7,[3]*7,[2]*7,[4]*7]
expected=[[4]*7,[7]*7,[6]*7,[6]*7,[3]*7,[2]*7,[4]*7]
assert mod.transform(demo)==expected
